# IOracleRegistry
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/rwa-oracles/src/interfaces/IOracleRegistry.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IOracleRegistryErrors](./i-oracle-registry-errors.md), [IOracleRegistryEvents](./i-oracle-registry-events.md)

**Title:**
IOracleRegistry

Interface for the Oracle Registry that maps asset tickers and addresses to their respective price oracles.


## Functions
### setOracle

Registers or updates a price oracle for a given ticker and asset address.


```solidity
function setOracle(string calldata ticker, address asset, address oracle) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`ticker`|`string`|The string symbol of the asset.|
|`asset`|`address`|The address of the asset contract.|
|`oracle`|`address`|The address of the price oracle contract.|


### getOracleByTicker

Retrieves the oracle address associated with a given ticker symbol.


```solidity
function getOracleByTicker(string calldata ticker) external view returns (address);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`ticker`|`string`|The string symbol of the asset.|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`address`|The address of the price oracle contract.|


### getOracleByAsset

Retrieves the oracle address associated with a given asset address.


```solidity
function getOracleByAsset(address asset) external view returns (address);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`asset`|`address`|The address of the asset.|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`address`|The address of the price oracle contract.|
